in_marathi.name: Prodip
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fire, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prodip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prodip is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prajapati', which means 'Lord of Creatures'. In Hindu mythology, Prajapati is the creator of all beings and the preserver of the universe. The name Prodip can also be derived from the Bengali word 'Prabip', which means 'Lord of Fire'. This name is therefore associated with the element of fire and the knowledge that comes from it.
